title: HMW gDNA Purification and ONT Ultra-Long-Read Data Generation
author: Glennis Logsdon
materials: Add the following reagents to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube on ice: 246 uL HMW gDNA 4 uL FRA Buffer Total = 250 uL

steps.title: Freeze cell pellet
steps.instruction: Freeze down approximately 2 × 10⁷ cells as a pellet and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Thaw cells and prepare RNase
steps.instruction: Thaw the cell pellet on ice for about 30 min; while thawing, add RNase A to the lysis buffer to a final concentration of 20 µg mL⁻¹ (prepare fresh each time) and keep the RNase‑containing lysis buffer at room temperature until use.

steps.title: Resuspend cells in TE
steps.instruction: Resuspend the thawed cells in 500 µL ice‑cold TE (pH 8.0) on ice.

steps.title: Transfer to Erlenmeyer
steps.instruction: Transfer the cell suspension to a 125‑mL glass Erlenmeyer flask and disperse the cells evenly over the inner surface to avoid clumping.

steps.title: Add lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Quickly add 5 mL lysis buffer containing RNase A drop‑wise in a circular motion, then swirl to mix.

steps.title: Lysis incubation
steps.instruction: Cover the flask with a parafilm lid and incubate the suspension for 1 h at 37 °C in a water bath.

steps.title: Add proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add proteinase K to a final concentration of 200 µg mL⁻¹ (50 µL for 5 mL lysate) drop‑wise and swirl gently to mix.

steps.title: Proteinase K digestion
steps.instruction: Incubate the lysate for 2 h at 50 °C in a water bath, swirling the viscous solution once per hour.

steps.title: Cool lysate
steps.instruction: Cool the lysate to room temperature.

steps.title: Transfer lysate to tube
steps.instruction: Transfer the viscous lysate to a 15‑mL conical tube using a 10‑mL serological pipette at low speed.

steps.title: First phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of ultra‑pure phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (≈5–5.5 mL) to the tube, then rotate the tube end‑over‑end for 10 min at 18 rpm on a Hulamixer in a fume hood.

steps.title: Phase separation
steps.instruction: Pour the mixture into a 15‑mL MaXtract tube containing a high‑density gel and centrifuge at 4000 rpm for 10 min.

steps.title: Collect aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous (upper) phase to a new 15‑mL conical tube.

steps.title: Second phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (≈5–5.5 mL), rotate end‑over‑end 10 min at 18 rpm on a Hulamixer, then transfer to a fresh 15‑mL MaXtract tube and centrifuge 4000 rpm for 10 min.

steps.title: Collect final aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous phase to a new 50‑mL conical tube.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with ammonium acetate
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL 5 M ammonium acetate (0.4 × lysate volume) and gently swirl for ~20 min.

steps.title: Ethanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL 100 % ethanol (2 × lysate volume) at room temperature, gently swirl for ~1 h, then store the precipitating DNA overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Collect DNA precipitate
steps.instruction: Using a disposable inoculating needle shaped into a ‘U’, remove the precipitate in one piece and place it into a 2‑mL DNA LoBind tube.

steps.title: Wash DNA precipitate
steps.instruction: Wash the precipitate twice with 1 mL 70 % ethanol, centrifuging at maximum speed (~15 000 rpm) for 15 s each wash.

steps.title: Air‑dry pellet
steps.instruction: Leave the open tube at room temperature for 1–2 min until the last visible ethanol evaporates; do not let the pellet dry completely.

steps.title: Resuspend in EB overnight
steps.instruction: Add 760 µL EB to the pellet and incubate without mixing at room temperature for 2 days to obtain a translucent viscous gel.

steps.title: Thaw library reagents
steps.instruction: Thaw the Fragmentation Mix (FRA), FRA Dilution Buffer (FDB), and Rapid Adapter (RA); spin briefly and keep on ice.

steps.title: Dilute and add FRA
steps.instruction: Mix the diluted FRA by pipetting, then add 250 µL diluted FRA to 750 µL extracted DNA on ice, stirring with the pipette tip while expelling the FRA to ensure even distribution.

steps.title: Mix tagmentation reaction
steps.instruction: Pipette the reaction slowly 10 times with a wide‑bore tip on ice to mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Tagmentation incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction sequentially: 10 min at room temperature, 10 min at 75 °C, then place on ice for >10 min.

steps.title: Add rapid adapter
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL Rapid Adapter with a regular tip, then mix by pipetting 5 times using a P1000 wide‑bore tip; verify the mixture is homogeneous.

steps.title: Adapter incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction for 1 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Add PTB and mix
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL PTB to the tube containing the gDNA, then rotate end‑over‑end for 10 min at 3 rpm on a Hulamixer; a glassy white mass should become visible.

steps.title: Centrifuge and discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Spin the tube at 1 000 g for 1 min, discard the supernatant carefully without disturbing the DNA precipitate, then pulse‑spin 1 s to remove residual liquid.

steps.title: Final EB resuspension
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL EB to the DNA precipitate and incubate overnight at room temperature.

steps.title: Gentle library mixing
steps.instruction: The next day, gently mix the DNA library by slow pipetting 5–10 times with a P1000 wide‑bore tip.

steps.title: Equilibrate flow cell
steps.instruction: Let a PromethION flow cell equilibrate to room temperature for ~20 min; ensure the light shield is in place.

steps.title: Run flow cell QC
steps.instruction: Place the flow cell onto the PromethION instrument and perform the platform quality‑control run.

steps.title: Prepare sequencing reagents
steps.instruction: Thaw Sequencing Buffer (SQB), Loading Solution UL (LSU), Flush Tether UL (FTU), and Flow Cell Flush (FCF) at room temperature; mix each by inverting and spin down briefly.

steps.title: Aliquot DNA library
steps.instruction: In a new 2‑mL tube, aliquot 100 µL of the DNA library using a P1000 wide‑bore tip.

steps.title: Incubate library aliquot
steps.instruction: Incubate the aliquoted library for 30–60 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Make priming mix
steps.instruction: In a 1.5‑mL tube, combine 30 µL FTU with 1170 µL FCF (total 1200 µL) and mix by pipetting.

steps.title: Flush inlet port
steps.instruction: Set a P1000 to ~500 µL, place the tip in the flow‑cell inlet port, turn the wheel right to expel air and a small amount of storage buffer so that the storage buffer level is flush with the inlet opening.

steps.title: Load priming mix (first)
steps.instruction: Load 500 µL of the priming mix (FTU + FCF) via the inlet port slowly, close the cover, and wait 5 min.

steps.title: Prepare library for loading
steps.instruction: Pipette up 200 µL of the DNA library with a P200 wide‑bore tip; then load another 500 µL of priming mix (FTU + FCF) via the inlet port slowly.

steps.title: Load DNA library
steps.instruction: Immediately load the 200 µL DNA library into the inlet port; optionally use a P1000 to draw the library into the flow cell from the waste port.

steps.title: Avoid air bubbles
steps.instruction: Ensure there are no gaps between successive library loads and avoid introducing air bubbles that could damage the nanopores.

steps.title: Pre‑run incubation
steps.instruction: Let the flow cell sit for at least 30 min before starting sequencing.

steps.title: Flow‑cell washing and reload
steps.instruction: Every 24 h, wash the flow cell and reload a fresh library; perform a total of 3–4 loads per flow cell. DNA from the first two loads may be recovered, stored at 4 °C, and reused for later runs.

steps.title: Thaw PTB and EB
steps.instruction: Thaw PTB and EB at room temperature, spin down briefly, and keep on ice.

steps.title: Measure library concentration
steps.instruction: Measure the DNA library concentration using a Nanodrop spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Keep library on ice
steps.instruction: Keep the DNA library on ice until loading; alternatively store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare loading buffer mix
steps.instruction: In a new 1.5‑mL tube, combine 100 µL SBU with 10 µL LSU (total 110 µL) and mix thoroughly by pipetting.

steps.title: Add buffer to library
steps.instruction: Add the 110 µL buffer mixture to the DNA library.

steps.title: Final library mixing
steps.instruction: Gently mix the reaction by slowly pipetting 5–10 times with a P1000 wide‑bore tip; visually confirm homogeneity.

steps.title: Final pulse‑spin
steps.instruction: Pulse‑spin the tube for 1 s and remove any remaining supernatant.
